greeting: Welcome to Meridian Blue. Para espanol, oprima el nueve. For providers, press 1.

root.prompt: For providers, press 1. For members, press 2.

member-dead-end.prompt: Please have your member call the number on the back of their card. Goodbye.

provider.prompt: For claim status, press 1. For prior authorization, press 2. For credentialing, press 3.
provider.failText: We did not receive a valid response. Goodbye.

member-id.prompt: Enter or say the member I D. Member I Ds are three letters followed by seven digits followed by one letter.
member-id.invalidText: That does not match a valid member I D.
member-id.failText: Too many invalid entries. Please call back with the member I D ready. Goodbye.

auth-id.prompt: Enter the ten digit authorization reference number.

auth-readout.template: Authorization {authRef} is approved for twelve units, valid through the last day of next month. Thank you.

dos.prompt: Enter the eight digit date of service. For example, zero six one five two zero two six.
dos.invalidText: That is not a valid date.

route.prompt: To hear automated claim status, press 1. To speak with a representative, press 0.

status-readout.template: Claim for member {memberId}, date of service {dos}, was received and is in process. Allow thirty days. Thank you for calling Meridian Blue.

hold.prompt: All representatives are assisting other callers. Your call will be answered in the order received.

rep.prompt: Provider services, you're speaking with a representative. Can I have the member I D you're calling about?
